name: Maria Anna Creszentia Mayer

events.title: Godmother to her niece Christina Mayer
events.description: 'M. Anna Mayer, wife of Joseph Wenz, citizen and shoemaker of here' stood godmother with her brother Friedrich.

events.title: Husband godfather to Friedrich Meier
events.description: Her husband Joseph Wenz, shoemaker, was godfather to her nephew Friedrich (later Frederick Meier of Hazleton).

bioAdditions: Maria Anna and her husband Joseph Wenz stood by her brother Friedrich's young family. Joseph Wenz, shoemaker, was godfather to Friedrich's first son in Jan 1862 (S2). In May 1864 'M. Anna Mayer, wife of Joseph Wenz, citizen and shoemaker' was godmother, alongside Friedrich himself, to the illegitimate daughter of her youngest sister Paulina (S1).
